_comment: DEC-24 step 7 / BUG-329 — fixable High or Critical findings in a pinned base image that were read and accepted for now. Each names the image, the vulnerability, the package, an owner, a reason and an expiry; an expired or unused entry fails scripts/scan_images.py. Prefer re-pinning the base to a rebuilt image over renewing.

exceptions.reason: Fixed in Alpine's zlib 1.3.2-r1, which the newest python:3.13-alpine image (2026-10-11) does not carry yet. The egress proxy image runs Raiker's stdlib-only proxy and inflates no untrusted compressed data; re-pin when the base is rebuilt
